mapper.sql: WITH first_ac AS ( SELECT sr.user_id, sr.question_id, MIN(sr.create_time) AS first_ac_time FROM submit_record sr JOIN question q ON q.id = sr.question_id AND q.deleted = 0 AND q.visibility = 'PUBLIC' WHERE sr.status = 'AC' GROUP BY sr.user_id, sr.question_id ), user_ac AS ( SELECT fa.user_id, COUNT(*) AS ac_count, MAX(fa.first_ac_time) AS reached_at FROM first_ac fa GROUP BY fa.user_id ), ranked AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.nickname, COALESCE(ua.ac_count, 0) AS ac_count, ua.reached_at AS reached_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY COALESCE(ua.ac_count, 0) DESC, COALESCE(ua.reached_at, u.create_time) ASC, u.id ASC ) AS rank_no, COUNT(*) OVER() AS total_users FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN user_ac ua ON ua.user_id = u.id WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, username, nickname, ac_count, reached_at, rank_no, total_users FROM ranked ORDER BY rank_no LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT user_id, username, nickname, ac_count, reached_at, rank_no, total_users FROM ranked WHERE user_id = #{userId}
